sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-OP key (RB-OP) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Airspace Control Center bunker command office.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text: - In a shelf in the "Generic" store

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Basement level of the Airspace Control Center (King) on Reserve.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables)
- 1x Drawer
- Intelligence folder spawn on the desk
